description: This file contains functions that interact with a backend API to retrieve and process organization (tenant) data, including listing organizations and summarizing organization usage details. It defines functions for API calls, data normalization, and aggregation.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches a list of organizations (tenants) authorized for the current user, normalizing and sorting the data.

methods.name: getOrganizationSummary(tenantId)
methods.description: Retrieves and summarizes usage data for a specific tenant, including total costs and user counts.
